parallels.note: This is the day that Yahweh has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!

translations.web: Land, don’t be afraid. Be glad and rejoice, for Yahweh has done great things.
translations.bsb: Do not be afraid, O land; rejoice and be glad, for the LORD has done great things.
translations.kjv: Fear not, O land; be glad and rejoice: for the LORD will do great things.
translations.asv: Fear not, O land, be glad and rejoice; for Jehovah hath done great things.
